name: Thiocolchicoside
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Adjuvant treatment of painful muscle contractures in acute spinal conditions (16 years and older)
usual_adult_dose.dose: Oral: up to 8 mg every 12 hours for at most 7 days. Intramuscular: up to 4 mg every 12 hours for at most 5 days

serious: Aneuploidy risk from a metabolite (preclinical): possible teratogenicity, miscarriage, impaired male fertility

contraindications: Women of childbearing potential not using effective contraception
Long-term treatment of chronic conditions (not recommended)

sources.citation: European Medicines Agency. (2014). Thiocolchicoside-containing medicines: Article 31 referral (Commission decision January 17, 2014; EMA/706409/2013).

revision_log.change: Dose/duration limit and aneuploidy risk placed first in monitoring; numbers unchanged (Annex III not separately cited).
